nickname.description: Nickname used to sign in, unique within the room.

aliases.description: Other spellings the group uses, including tone-free forms.

walkable.description: Can the group walk there from the office?

draft_id.description: The # shown on the draft card.

target.description: Member to remove: nickname or numeric id.

all_active.description: True to fetch all active members ('cả nhóm').

names.description: Names to look up (e.g. ['An', 'Bình']). Pass the name EXACTLY as the user wrote it — the tool matches display name, nickname, aliases and the bank account holder, with or without Vietnamese tones, and strips 'anh'/'chị' itself. Do not de-accent or shorten it yourself.

all.description: Return every place in the room.

names.description: Place names as the user wrote them ('thịnh lơ', 'quán bé bự').

label.description: What the pick is for, as the user said it ('trả tiền', 'đi mua đồ ăn'). Cosmetic only.

day_word.description: The day EXACTLY as the user said it ('thứ 5', 'hôm qua', '20/7'). The tool resolves it to a date (ICT) — never compute the date yourself. Omit = today.

discount_split.description: Only with `items`. How to share the gap between Σ items and `total`: 'proportional' (default) scales each dish price; 'equal' takes the same amount off everyone — use it when the user says so ('chia đều phần giảm', 'mỗi người trừ như nhau'). Either way the TOOL does the arithmetic.

items.description: Per-person mode ('ai ăn nấy trả'): the LIST price of what each person ate, copied straight off the bill — do NOT pre-apply the discount or split the difference yourself. One entry per participant, every participant exactly once. The tool prorates the gap between Σ items and `total` (promo, ship, service fee) across the items. Omit this to split the bill evenly. **Only when you KNOW who ate what** — the user said so, or the bill writes a name next to each line. A bill that merely lists dishes does not say who ordered them: guessing changes what each person owes and looks correct while being invented. Split evenly instead.

amount.description: Its price on the bill, integer VND.

occurred_on.description: Deprecated: pre-resolved meal date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Prefer `day_word` so the tool does the date math. Ignored when `day_word` is given.

participants.description: member ids of EVERYONE who ate, the sender included when they ate ('tôi với Bình ăn' = both ids).

payer.description: member id of the payer; blank = the sender.

amount.description: Integer VND (125k → 125000). OMIT to pay off exactly what `from` currently owes `to`.

from.description: member id who paid; blank = the sender.

mode.description: For a two-way pair only: 'gross' = pay the full amount `from` owes `to`; 'offset' = settle the net difference. Omit otherwise.

to.description: member id who received the money.

from.description: ISO date. Supplying from/to means an explicit range; omit `keyword` (or pass 'explicit').

budget.description: Only places in this price band.

delivery.description: True when the group wants to order in rather than walk out.

exclude.description: Places to leave out ('vừa ăn hôm qua rồi').

active.description: Set true to restore a previously removed member.

default_participant.description: Whether this member is swept into a 'whole group' chia tien split or rot tra draw by default. Set false to exclude an irregular/casual member — they can still be added to a specific activity by name. Defaults true.

nickname.description: New nickname; must be unique in the room.

target.description: Member to update: nickname or numeric id.
